plan: This auction structure is equivalent to a second-price sealed-bid auction: the winner pays the second-highest bid, regardless of the ascending clock mechanism. In such auctions, bidding your true value is the dominant strategy - it maximizes expected profit regardless of others' bids. Since my value is $46, I should bid exactly $46 to ensure I win whenever profitable and never overpay.

This mechanism is equivalent to a second-price (Vickrey) auction: the winner pays the second-highest sealed bid, and my exit point is determined by my own bid. Since payment doesn't depend on my own bid (only on the second-highest), truthful bidding is the dominant strategy. Bidding exactly my value of $17 ensures I win whenever profitable (value exceeds price) and avoid losses otherwise. No history to adjust from since this is the only round.

Since this is effectively a second-price sealed-bid auction (winner pays the second-highest bid), the dominant strategy is to bid my true value.
